items.title: Jailed former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson being investigated over alleged rape inside Parliament
items.summary: While not naming the disgraced former MP, the Metropolitan Police has issued a statement confirming a 63-year-old man is being investigated.

items.title: Jailed former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson accused of raping woman inside Westminster - reports
items.summary: Police are investigating former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson over an allegation that he raped a woman in the Houses of Parliament, the PA news agency reports.

items.title: Lawyer caught offering to make illegal-worker fine go away
items.summary: Because of our investigation, the home secretary has ordered a review of how fines are issued and collected.

items.title: Websites across Europe go offline after warning issued for critical software update
items.summary: Organisations unable to apply key fixes to widely used software should consider taking their websites down, UK and international cybersecurity officials have warned.

items.title: Teenage boy guilty of trying to murder girl, 15, in school
items.summary: The school went into lockdown and parents gathered at the gates as they waited for news about their children.

items.title: Three more people arrested over death of Manchester woman
items.summary: Three more people have been arrested over the death of Alisha Samuels in Manchester.
